a.lede: GTA 6, the biggest release of the year, will be console-only at launch, with a PC launch now expected within the first three months of 2027.
a.title: GTA 6 could come to PC as early as Q1 2027, leak claims

b.lede: That would be a much smaller port time than GTA 5.
b.title: GTA 6 is reportedly coming to PC in early 2027
